definitions.explanation: A wide, expansive view seen from a high or distant vantage point. Emphasizes the act of gazing out over a landscape and the scenery itself.

examples.japanese: {眺望|ちょうぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すばらしい。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{眺望|ちょうぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: You can enjoy an ocean view from this room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山頂|さんちょう}→山頂：09942_sanchou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{眺望|ちょうぼう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{息|いき}を{呑|の}む→息を呑む：06902_ikiwonomu⟧ほど⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The panoramic view from the mountaintop was breathtakingly beautiful.

notes:
A somewhat formal or literary word for a panoramic view from an elevated or distant vantage point. Composed of ⟦{眺|なが}める→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧ (to gaze) + ⟦{望|のぞ}む→望む：01976_nozomu⟧ (to look out over), both characters conveying the sense of looking far into the distance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {眺望|ちょうぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to have a good view
- {眺望|ちょうぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: to enjoy the view
- {眺望|ちょうぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}ける→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: the view opens up
- {眺望|ちょうぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遮|さえぎ}る→遮る：10876_saegiru⟧: to block the view
- {眺望|ちょうぼう}⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧: viewpoint, scenic lookout

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧: scenery — the most common everyday word for natural scenery
- ⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧: landscape — slightly more literary; used for broader scenic views
- ⟦{展望|てんぼう}→展望：12393_tenbou⟧: outlook, prospect — often used for observation decks (⟦{展望台|てんぼうだい}→展望台：18278_tenboudai⟧) and figuratively for future prospects
- ⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧: view — more casual and conversational than {眺望|ちょうぼう}

USAGE:
Frequently used in real estate listings, travel writing, and hotel descriptions to highlight scenic views. More formal than ⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧ and emphasizes grandeur.
